purpose: Sanitized observed V1 history reference scenarios for Fuel Calculator V2 bottom-half workbench development. These are comparison/acceptance evidence only; they are not Fuel V2 format-2 sidecars and must never be imported as classified learned history.

sourcePolicy.sanitization: Driver/team identity, capture paths, session identifiers, and wall-clock timestamps are omitted. Observed quantitative session, fuel, pit, and stint facts are retained.
sourcePolicy.runtimeAuthority: Live telemetry remains the runtime authority. These scenarios establish review expectations and degraded-state guardrails only.

bottomHalfAssertions: At the start, a four-lap no-stop candidate must remain a visible saving/stretch comparison, not unconditional advice.
A normal plan must retain a feasible stop path; the real session contained a fuel-service stop.
The workbench must distinguish the historical conservative burn from the first-stint observed burn rather than silently averaging them.

evidenceNotes: Timed race with unlimited declared laps; final-lap planning must use a live lap budget rather than infer a fixed lap count from this record.

bottomHalfAssertions: The bottom half must accept a timed-race lap budget as a separate live input; this history supplies burn and service reference, not a final lap target.
A fuel-only service can provide a credible fill-rate reference only when the service-active/fuel-delta evidence is present.
The model must retain the known service stop rather than interpret a low post-stint fuel value as evidence of a no-stop plan.

evidenceNotes: Only 4.07 of a declared 50 laps were observed.
The material service included a tire change, so its elapsed time and apparent fill rate cannot be promoted as fuel-only service authority.

bottomHalfAssertions: The model must enter a degraded/insufficient-history state for any whole-race 50-lap stop count; it cannot extrapolate a final plan from four observed laps.
The tire-service elapsed time and apparent fill rate must not be used as a fuel-only service rate.
The observed burn may be displayed as a provisional live/history reference with its medium-confidence context, never as an unconditional race plan.
